attributes.name: Shocking Chest
attributes.powers:
After you act, if the result of your check to defeat less than 17, each character at your location is dealt 1d4 Electricity damage.

If undefeated, you may banish this barrier.

If defeated, draw a weapon, a spell, and an item from the box.
